We shall define energy for an arbitrary system as

[Source paragraph 3; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

We sometimes write Equation 2.38 in its intensive form as

[Source paragraph 4; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

Recall from our earlier discussions that an intensive property is the associated extensive property divided by mass.

[Source paragraph 5; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

For a fixed mass of material, undergoing some thermodynamic process, the first law of thermodynamics can be written as

[Source paragraph 6; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

The subscript 1-2 simply lets us know that the process began at some state 1 and ends at some state 2. The signs on the terms are very important. We assume a positive change in energy comes about by adding heat to the system and doing work on the system. Thus, work performed on the system is positive and heat added is positive. Different thermodynamics texts write the first law slightly differently, but if you understand that the net result of work on the system or heat transfer to the system is to increase its energy, then few mistakes will be made.

[Source paragraph 7; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

We shall now explicitly write out Equation 2.40 for a Lagrangian system

If this is the case, we can rewrite Equation 2.41 using our relationship between the two from Equation 2.40. We shall use the intensive form of Equation 2.40 to yield

Here we note that  $h$  is the specific enthalpy and  $v$  is the specific volume.

[Source paragraph 11; 2.4 Thermodynamics; intervening text may be omitted]

general.boundary: 在领域内可复用的事实、规律或概念定义。标准术语的通用定义归此类；不能仅因原文出现‘定义’就判为局部约定。

conditional.label: 条件性知识
conditional.boundary: 在明确条件下可复用的领域事实；必须保留条件、频率、否定和模态。不能把‘在条件下成立’等同于局部符号约定。

local_definition.label: 局部定义或符号约定
local_definition.boundary: 仅在当前章节、推导或作者语境中约定的符号、命名和临时定义；不能直接推广为领域通用事实。

derivation.label: 推导步骤
derivation.boundary: 为获得结论而采用的中间变形或证明过程。独立成立、可复用的最终定理按一般或条件性知识判断。

example.label: 教学示例
example.boundary: 仅为演示方法而设定的具体对象、数值或情形；示例之外被明确支持的一般规律可单独审核。

unresolved.label: 类别待确认
unresolved.boundary: 上下文不足、类别分歧或有效审核席位不足时保留待确认，不由模型自行决定收录或排除。
